_about: Copy this to gigs/secrets.json (which is gitignored) and put your REAL credentials here. Never put real passwords in config.json — it is tracked by git and would be pushed to GitHub. Values here override the matching blocks in config.json. Env vars override both: GIG_SMTP_PASSWORD, GIG_IMAP_PASSWORD, GIG_SMTP_USERNAME, GIG_IMAP_USERNAME.
